learner_words: The chain race was faster. I got a lot of them. Sometimes I said the blend backwards — like I'd say the wrong one first. I knew it was wrong after I said it.
guide_note: Wednesday session, Ash did this mid-afternoon. I was working. Checked the results later — 11 out of 14, level 2 again. Game noted reversals in blends twice. Ash seemed a bit tired when I saw them after but not frustrated. Good improvement on the score from Monday.
